name: compound_interest
description: Compound-interest arithmetic: future and present value of a sum and of a level annuity (ordinary or due), the effective annual rate of a nominal rate compounded m times a year or continuously, the nominal rate of an effective one, doubling time exactly and by the rules of 72, 70 and 69.3, and the real rate by Fisher's equation. Decimal arithmetic, positive amounts.

compounding.description: Compoundings (and payments) a year, default 1, or "continuous"

periods.description: Instead of years: years x compounding

future_value.description: present_value: sum wanted at the end

due.description: Payments at the start of each period

catalog.source: original; the time-value formulas of Excel FV, PV, EFFECT and NOMINAL, whose help-page examples the tests reproduce, and Fisher (1930) for the real rate
